title: top-up: read-only role guard
definition: worker/deno/lib/orchestration/read_only_guard.ts: records a git checkout (HEAD, branch, index bytes and a scratch-index tree of tracked and untracked files) before a read-only Codex role call and puts back whatever the call changed; git runs through the runGitCommand chokepoint with fixed argv, the only env is a GIT_INDEX_FILE temp path the module creates and removes (#4356)
